name: Resteclin 500mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE

RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE contains Tetracycline which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, bronchitis or whooping cough, urinary tract infections, sexually transmitted diseases such as chlamydia, gonorrhoea or syphilis, skin infection such as acne, eye infection such as conjunctivitis, rickettsial infection such as Q fever or tick fever (severe headache, rash, high fever).

It is also used to manage other infection including brucellosis (headache, sickness, fever, swollen lymph nodes), psittacosis (headache, nose bleeds, shivering, fever), plague (painful swelling of the lymph nodes), cholera (severe sickness and diarrhoea), leptospirosis (fever, causing jaundice or meningitis), gas-gangrene and tetanus (lock jaw).

RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver, kidney disease, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). Contact your doctor before taking it.

GBNKEYWORD] is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, in children under 12 years of age. RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients with kidney disease. Contact your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, urticaria, photosensitivity, increased pigmentation. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE Works

RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE is a broad-spectrum antibiotic works by stopping the growth or killing the bacteria. Thus helps to reduce the infection in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE

Take RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine one hour before or two hours after meals, followed by a glass of water.  Swallow the medicine when standing or sitting down, do not take them immediately before going to bed.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE early as your infection may return if you do not finish the course of this medicine.

warnings.details: RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy as it affects bone development and causes permanent teeth discolouration in unborn baby. Consult your doctor before taking RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE.
RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as this medicine passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE.
RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease. Contact your doctor before taking RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE.
RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. Contact your doctor before taking RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE.
Do not take RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to tetracycline, other similar antibiotics (such as minocycline or doxycycline) or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with asthma. Consult your doctor before taking RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE.

Others

RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE is not recommended for you, if you:

Have systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) (a condition characterised by a rash on the face, hair loss, fever, malaise and joint pain)

Before taking RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (a condition characterised by muscle weakness, difficulty chewing and swallowing and slurred speech)
Are sensitive to sunlight
Have allergies, hives, hay fever

Use in pediatrics:

RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age. It can cause permanent discolouration of tooth enamel and affect bone development. Contact your doctor before taking RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE.

Use in geriatrics:

RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients with kidney disease. Contact your doctor before taking RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Penicillins such as phenoxymethylpenicillin (used to manage infections)
Vitamin A (used to manage vitamin A deficiency and night-blindness)
Retinoids such as acitretin, isotretinoin and tretinoin (used to manage acne)
Oral contraceptives (medicines used to manage pregnancy) Ex. levonorgestrel
Anticoagulants (used to stop the blood clotting) Ex. warfarin
Diuretics such as furosemide (used to remove extra fluid in the body)
Kaolin-pectin and bismuth subsalicylate (used to manage diarrhoea)
Medicines such as insulin, glibenclamide or gliclazide (used to manage diabetes)
Anaesthetic such as methoxyflurane (used in anaesthesia)
Atovaquone (used to manage pneumonia)
Antacids such as aluminium, calcium, iron, magnesium, bismuth or zinc salts (used to manage indigestion, heartburn)
Sucralfate (used to manage ulcers)
Lithium (used to manage bipolar disorder, depression)
Digoxin (used to manage heart failure)
Methotrexate (used in rheumatoid arthritis)
Strontium ranelate (used for osteoporosis)
Colestipol or colestyramine (used to manage high cholesterol)
Ergotamine and methysergide (used to manage or manage migraine)

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Do not take this medicine with milk or food at the same time, as they can make the medicine less effective.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose of RESTECLIN 500MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, crystals or blood in the urine, hypersensitivity reactions.

name: Edox DT 100mg Tablet 8'S
introduction:
Introduction About EDOX DT 100MG TABLET

EDOX DT 100MG TABLET contains Doxycycline which belongs to group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used for the management of various bacterial infections like that of chest, lung or nose (Ex. bronchitis, pneumonia, sinusitis), urinary tract (Ex. cystitis, urethritis), skin (Ex. acne), eyes or sexually transmitted diseases (Ex. gonorrhoea, syphilis, chlamydia).

EDOX DT 100MG TABLET is also used to manage fevers associated with louse or tick bites and malaria (when chloroquine is ineffective). EDOX DT 100MG TABLET can also be used to manage certain infections like scrub typhus (a disease carried by small insects), Rocky Mountain spotted fever, travellers’ diarrhoea, malaria and leptospirosis.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with EDOX DT 100MG TABLET, as it may reduce the efficacy of this medicine. Before taking EDOX DT 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, liver or kidney problems, porphyria, diarrhea or suspected syphilis.

EDOX DT 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant, planning to become pregnant or breast-feeding. EDOX DT 100MG TABLET should be used in children (8 years of age or less) only if the potential benefits outweigh the risks.

You should avoid exposure to strong sunlight while taking EDOX DT 100MG TABLET as your skin may be more sensitive to sunburn than normal. The most common side effects of taking EDOX DT 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, joint pain, skin rash, fever, headache, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse with time.

name: Minoz ER 65mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET

MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose, and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. It also helps in the management of meningitis carriers. It is also used in the management of infections before and after an operation.

Before taking MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding as it can affect the development of the unborn baby. MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET should be used with caution by adults and adolescents but not recommended for use under the age of 12 years. The most common side effects of taking MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET are dizziness and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET Works

MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET has properties of immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects. It can work by any of the following mechanism such as inhibitory effect on activities of enzymes such as MMPs or iNOS; reduction in protein tyrosine nitration because of scavenging properties; inhibition of activation of caspase-1 and caspase 3; enhancement of Bcl-2-derived effects which protects the cells against apoptosis; inhibition of the activity of PARP-1; reduction in the amount of p38 MAPK phosphorylation. All these activities of minocycline help in fighting against various bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET

Take MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. You can take MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET while sitting down or standing.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use by pregnant women or women who are planning to conceive, as it can affect the development of the foetus. Consult your doctor before taking it.
MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, spinning sensation while standing, headaches, eyesight problems, light-headedness, ringing in the ears or hearing problems after taking MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET. The absorption of MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET can be affected by food, milk or milk products.
MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET if you are allergic to minocycline.

Others

MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an autoimmune disorder where the immune system of the body attacks its tissue causing damage and inflammation of various parts of the body)
Have a need for dialysis management

Before taking MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (a condition which causes muscle weakening)

Use in paediatrics:

MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET is generally not recommended for under 12 years of age as it can affect growing bones and teeth and cause staining of teeth along with reduced enamel content in teeth. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

MINOZ ER 65MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Microdox Lbx Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MICRODOX LBX CAPSULE

MICRODOX LBX CAPSULE is a combination of Doxycycline and Lactic Acid Bacillus, which belong to the groups of medicines called antibiotics and probiotics, respectively. It is used in adults prone to intra-abdominal bacterial infection and to manage antibiotic-associated diarrhoea.

Before taking MICRODOX LBX CAPSULE, inform your doctor about your pre-existing conditions, allergies or if you are taking any other medicines. MICRODOX LBX CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women or children (younger than 8 years), so consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking MICRODOX LBX CAPSULE are loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, rash, light sensitivity, hives and haemolytic anaemia. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse.
uses: Manage intra-abdominal bacterial infection
Manage antibiotic-associated diarrhea
usesDetails:

Manage intra-abdominal bacterial infection
Manage antibiotic-associated diarrhea
mechanismOfAction:
How MICRODOX LBX CAPSULE Works

MICRODOX LBX CAPSULE improves gastrointestinal symptoms where doxycycline gets accumulated inside the bacteria, gets attached to the 30S subunit of the bacterial ribosome and inhibits bacterial protein synthesis; lactobacillus restores the natural microbial flora within the digestive tract and helps in the breakdown of food, resulting in the production of lactic acid, hydrogen peroxide and other by-products.
usageDetails:
How to use MICRODOX LBX CAPSULE

Take MICRODOX LBX CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will determine your correct dose and duration based on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Resteclin 250mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About RESTECLIN 250MG CAPSULE

RESTECLIN 250MG CAPSULE contains Tetracycline which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, bronchitis or whooping cough, urinary tract infections, sexually transmitted diseases such as chlamydia, gonorrhoea or syphilis, skin infection such as acne, eye infection such as conjunctivitis, rickettsial infection such as Q fever or tick fever (severe headache, rash, high fever).

It is also used to manage other infection including brucellosis (headache, sickness, fever, swollen lymph nodes), psittacosis (headache, nose bleeds, shivering, fever), plague (painful swelling of the lymph nodes), cholera (severe sickness and diarrhoea), leptospirosis (fever, causing jaundice or meningitis), gas-gangrene and tetanus (lock jaw).

RESTECLIN 250MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver, kidney disease, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). Contact your doctor before taking it.

GBNKEYWORD] is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, in children under 12 years of age. RESTECLIN 250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients with kidney disease. Contact your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking RESTECLIN 250MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, urticaria, photosensitivity, increased pigmentation. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

Take RESTECLIN 250MG CAPSULE as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine one hour before or two hours after meals, followed by a glass of water.  Swallow the medicine when standing or sitting down, do not take them immediately before going to bed.

name: Minoz 50mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MINOZ 50MG TABLET

MINOZ 50MG TABLET contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose, and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. It also helps in the management of meningitis carriers. It is also used in the management of infections before and after an operation.

Before taking MINOZ 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking MINOZ 50MG TABLET, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

MINOZ 50MG TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding as it can affect the development of the unborn baby. MINOZ 50MG TABLET should be used with caution by adults and adolescents but not recommended for use under the age of 12 years. The most common side effects of taking MINOZ 50MG TABLET are dizziness and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MINOZ 50MG TABLET Works

MINOZ 50MG TABLET has properties of immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects. It can work by any of the following mechanism such as inhibitory effect on activities of enzymes such as MMPs or iNOS; reduction in protein tyrosine nitration because of scavenging properties; inhibition of activation of caspase-1 and caspase 3; enhancement of Bcl-2-derived effects which protects the cells against apoptosis; inhibition of the activity of PARP-1; reduction in the amount of p38 MAPK phosphorylation. All these activities of minocycline help in fighting against various bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MINOZ 50MG TABLET

Take MINOZ 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. You can take MINOZ 50MG TABLET while sitting down or standing.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

MINOZ 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an autoimmune disorder where the immune system of the body attacks its tissue causing damage and inflammation of various parts of the body)
Have a need for dialysis management

Before taking MINOZ 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (a condition which causes muscle weakening)

Use in paediatrics:

MINOZ 50MG TABLET is generally not recommended for under 12 years of age as it can affect growing bones and teeth and cause staining of teeth along with reduced enamel content in teeth. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

MINOZ 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About DOXYDAY CAPSULE

DOXYDAY CAPSULE is a combination of Doxycycline and Saccharomyces Boulardii which belongs to the group of medicines called Tetracycline antibiotics and Probiotics. It helps to manage inflammatory bowel diseases like colitis. Colitis is an inflammatory bowel disease which causes inflammation and ulcers in the large intestine. It is characterized by intense pain and tenderness in the stomach, weight loss, loss of appetite, joint pain, general weakness, watery diarrhea, and fever.

DOXYDAY CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients having liver, and severe kidney problems, myasthenia gravis, porphyria, systemic lupus erythematous, diarrhoea, and syphilis. Consult your doctor before taking DOXYDAY CAPSULE. DOXYDAY CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

DOXYDAY CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents aged below 8 years. DOXYDAY CAPSULE is not recommended for use in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice before taking it. The most common side effects of taking DOXYDAY CAPSULE are sunlight sensitivity, headache, low blood pressure, nausea (feeling sick), and vomiting. Consult your physician if the symptoms are not improving.
uses: Manages inflammatory bowel diseases like colitis
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOXYDAY CAPSULE
Manages inflammatory bowel diseases like colitis
mechanismOfAction:
How DOXYDAY CAPSULE Works

DOXYDAY CAPSULE is effective in colitis where doxycycline acts by stopping the growth of disease-causing bacteria by inhibiting the protein synthesis necessary for bacterial growth. Saccharomyces Boulardi works by inhibiting the action of toxic products released by the bacteria and inhibits the production of cytokines thereby reducing inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use DOXYDAY CAPSULE

Always take DOXYDAY CAPSULE as directed by your physician. Swallow the DOXYDAY CAPSULE as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, frequency and duration depending on your condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MINOZ 100MG TABLET

MINOZ 100MG TABLET contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose, and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. It also helps in the management of meningitis carriers. It is also used in the management of infections before and after an operation.

Before taking MINOZ 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking MINOZ 100MG TABLET, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

MINOZ 100MG TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding as it can affect the development of the unborn baby. MINOZ 100MG TABLET should be used with caution by adults and adolescents but not recommended for use under the age of 12 years. The most common side effects of taking MINOZ 100MG TABLET are dizziness and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MINOZ 100MG TABLET Works

MINOZ 100MG TABLET has properties of immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects. It can work by any of the following mechanism such as inhibitory effect on activities of enzymes such as MMPs or iNOS; reduction in protein tyrosine nitration because of scavenging properties; inhibition of activation of caspase-1 and caspase 3; enhancement of Bcl-2-derived effects which protects the cells against apoptosis; inhibition of the activity of PARP-1; reduction in the amount of p38 MAPK phosphorylation. All these activities of minocycline help in fighting against various bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MINOZ 100MG TABLET

Take MINOZ 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. You can take MINOZ 100MG TABLET while sitting down or standing.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CNN 50MG TABLET

CNN 50MG TABLET contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose, and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. It also helps in the management of meningitis carriers. It is also used in the management of infections before and after an operation.

Before taking CNN 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking CNN 50MG TABLET, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

CNN 50MG TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding as it can affect the development of the unborn baby. CNN 50MG TABLET should be used with caution by adults and adolescents but not recommended for use under the age of 12 years. The most common side effects of taking CNN 50MG TABLET are dizziness and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CNN 50MG TABLET Works

CNN 50MG TABLET has properties of immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects. It can work by any of the following mechanism such as inhibitory effect on activities of enzymes such as MMPs or iNOS; reduction in protein tyrosine nitration because of scavenging properties; inhibition of activation of caspase-1 and caspase 3; enhancement of Bcl-2-derived effects which protects the cells against apoptosis; inhibition of the activity of PARP-1; reduction in the amount of p38 MAPK phosphorylation. All these activities of minocycline help in fighting against various bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use CNN 50MG TABLET

Take CNN 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. You can take CNN 50MG TABLET while sitting down or standing.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: CNN 50MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use by pregnant women or women who are planning to conceive, as it can affect the development of the foetus. Consult your doctor before taking it.
CNN 50MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, spinning sensation while standing, headaches, eyesight problems, light-headedness, ringing in the ears or hearing problems after taking CNN 50MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CNN 50MG TABLET. The absorption of CNN 50MG TABLET can be affected by food, milk or milk products.
CNN 50MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
CNN 50MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CNN 50MG TABLET if you are allergic to minocycline.

Others

CNN 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an autoimmune disorder where the immune system of the body attacks its tissue causing damage and inflammation of various parts of the body)
Have a need for dialysis management

Before taking CNN 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (a condition which causes muscle weakening)

Use in paediatrics:

CNN 50MG TABLET is generally not recommended for under 12 years of age as it can affect growing bones and teeth and cause staining of teeth along with reduced enamel content in teeth. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

CNN 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CNN 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Anticoagulants (used to thin blood) Ex. warfarin
Antacids (used to manage indigestion) Ex. – magnesium hydroxide and calcium carbonate
Hepatotoxic medicine (medicines that might affect the working of the liver)
Sucralfate and bismuth salts (used to manage ulcers)
Kaolin (used to manage diarrhoea)
Quinapril (ACE inhibitor, used to manage high blood pressure)
Antibiotic (a medicine used to manage infections) Ex. – penicillin
Diuretics Ex. bumetanide and furosemide
Retinoids (used to manage acne) Ex. isotretinoin or retinol
Ergotamine (used to manage migraines)
Ergometrine (used to induce labour or abortion)
Medicines containing zinc salts, calcium, iron, magnesium, or aluminium

B. Drug–Food Interactions:

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking CNN 50MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects. The absorption of CNN 50MG TABLET can be reduced by food, milk or milk products.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of CNN 50MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness and feeling sick or nauseous.

name: DOXYNEC Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About DOXYNEC CAPSULE

DOXYNEC CAPSULE is a combination of Doxycycline and Lactic Acid Bacillus, which belong to the groups of medicines called antibiotics and probiotics, respectively. It is used in adults prone to intra-abdominal bacterial infection and to manage antibiotic-associated diarrhoea.

Before taking DOXYNEC CAPSULE, inform your doctor about your pre-existing conditions, allergies or if you are taking any other medicines. DOXYNEC CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women or children (younger than 8 years), so consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking DOXYNEC CAPSULE are loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, rash, light sensitivity, hives and haemolytic anaemia. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse.
uses: Manage intra-abdominal bacterial infection
Manage antibiotic-associated diarrhea
usesDetails:

Manage intra-abdominal bacterial infection
Manage antibiotic-associated diarrhea
mechanismOfAction:
How DOXYNEC CAPSULE Works

DOXYNEC CAPSULE improves gastrointestinal symptoms where doxycycline gets accumulated inside the bacteria, gets attached to the 30S subunit of the bacterial ribosome and inhibits bacterial protein synthesis; lactobacillus restores the natural microbial flora within the digestive tract and helps in the breakdown of food, resulting in the production of lactic acid, hydrogen peroxide and other by-products.
usageDetails:
How to use DOXYNEC CAPSULE

Take DOXYNEC CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will determine your correct dose and duration based on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Inflammation is seen in various parts such as the liver, blood vessels, tongue, vagina or mouth, and intestines which causes severe nausea and vomiting, stomach cramps or diarrhoea and itching of the anus. These are indicative of the growth of tetracycline-resistance bacteria
Recurrent and frequent infections causing fever, chest infections, severe chills, or mouth ulcers. These are signs of low WBCs levels in the blood
Dark urine, pale stools, loss of appetite, yellowing of skin or whites of eyes, and stomach pain. These are indications of serious liver problems.
Fatigue, chest pain or pressure and shortness of breath during exercise are signs of inflamed heart muscles (myocarditis)
Sudden sharp chest pain which aggravates by deep breathing or coughing. These are signs of inflammation of the membrane surrounding the heart (pericarditis)
Muscle pain
Inflammation, pain, swelling or stiffness of joints with fever
Allergic reaction is seen as red itchy swollen skin, severe skin rashes, and swelling seen on the face, mouth, lips, tongue, or throat which results in breathing difficulties
Tiredness, weakness, or pale skin
Breathing problems such as wheezing, shortness of breath at rest, coughing with chest tightness or worsening of asthma
Stomach cramps, watery diarrhoea might be with blood, loss of appetite, and feeling sick (nausea or being sick). This may be a sign of pancreas inflammation
Severe skin reactions, blistering of skin, mouth, genitals, and eyes, peeling, or flaking of skin
Hair loss, weight loss, fever, rash (especially on the face), generalized feeling of being unwell and pain in joints. These are signs of Systemic Lupus Erythematous
Fits
Changes in the level of blood cells (drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms – DRESS)

name: Edox Capsule 8'S
introduction:
Introduction About EDOX 100MG CAPSULE

EDOX 100MG CAPSULE contains Doxycycline which belongs to group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used for the management of various bacterial infections like that of chest, lung or nose (Ex. bronchitis, pneumonia, sinusitis), urinary tract (Ex. cystitis, urethritis), skin (Ex. acne), eyes or sexually transmitted diseases (Ex. gonorrhoea, syphilis, chlamydia).

EDOX 100MG CAPSULE is also used to manage fevers associated with louse or tick bites and malaria (when chloroquine is ineffective). EDOX 100MG CAPSULE can also be used to manage certain infections like scrub typhus (a disease carried by small insects), Rocky Mountain spotted fever, travellers’ diarrhoea, malaria and leptospirosis.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with EDOX 100MG CAPSULE, as it may reduce the efficacy of this medicine. Before taking EDOX 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, liver or kidney problems, porphyria, diarrhea or suspected syphilis.

EDOX 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant, planning to become pregnant or breast-feeding. EDOX 100MG CAPSULE should be used in children (8 years of age or less) only if the potential benefits outweigh the risks.

You should avoid exposure to strong sunlight while taking EDOX 100MG CAPSULE as your skin may be more sensitive to sunburn than normal. The most common side effects of taking EDOX 100MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, joint pain, skin rash, fever, headache, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse with time.

introduction:
Introduction About LENTECLIN LB CAPSULE

LENTECLIN LB CAPSULE is a combination of Doxycycline and Lactic Acid Bacillus, which belong to the groups of medicines called antibiotics and probiotics, respectively. It is used in adults prone to intra-abdominal bacterial infection and to manage antibiotic-associated diarrhoea.

Before taking LENTECLIN LB CAPSULE, inform your doctor about your pre-existing conditions, allergies or if you are taking any other medicines. LENTECLIN LB CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women or children (younger than 8 years), so consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking LENTECLIN LB CAPSULE are loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, rash, light sensitivity, hives and haemolytic anaemia. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse.

Take LENTECLIN LB CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will determine your correct dose and duration based on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MINYM GEL

MINYM GEL contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Tetracyclines. It is used in adults and children above 9 years of age to manage pimples and red bumps (non-nodular inflammatory lesions) associated with moderate to severe acne vulgaris. Acne vulgaris is a common skin disorder that can present with both inflammatory and non-inflammatory lesions. It may arise due to the use of some medicines, excess oil production, sunlight exposure, hormonal abnormalities, etc.

Your doctor will advise you to limit your sunlight exposure and avoid sunlight or artificial sunlight such as sunlamps or tanning beds while using MINYM GEL to manage photosensitivity and sunburn. While going out, wear loose-fitting clothes and apply sunscreen for skin protection.

It is not recommended to use MINYM GEL if you are allergic to tetracyclines. Before using MINYM GEL, inform your doctor if you have liver problems, kidney diseases or watery stools (diarrhoea). Inform your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to get pregnant or breastfeeding before starting to use MINYM GEL.

It is not advised to use MINYM GEL in children under the age of nine. The most common side effect of using MINYM GEL is a headache. Consult your doctor if it worsens over time.

It is used in adults and children above 9 years to manage pimples and red bumps (non-nodular inflammatory lesions) associated with moderate to severe acne vulgaris.
mechanismOfAction:
How MINYM GEL Works

MINYM GEL contains minocycline, which is a tetracycline antibiotic. Minocycline blocks the protein production of bacteria by binding to its ribosomal units. It leads to the management of the growth and development of bacteria that causes the death of bacteria and reduction in inflammation. Thus, it helps to manage pimples.

Apply MINYM GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before applying MINYM GEL. Take a cherry-sized amount of medicine into your fingertip. Apply on the affected areas. Avoid contact with your mouth, eyes, nose and vagina. It is better to use this medicine at the same time every day, 1 hour before bedtime for better results. Patients are advised not to take a shower or wash your face for at least 1 hour after applying MINYM GEL.

introduction:
Introduction About MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE

MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose, and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. It also helps in the management of meningitis carriers. It is also used in the management of infections before and after an operation.

Before taking MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding as it can affect the development of the unborn baby. MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution by adults and adolescents but not recommended for use under the age of 12 years. The most common side effects of taking MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE are dizziness and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE Works

MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE has properties of immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects. It can work by any of the following mechanism such as inhibitory effect on activities of enzymes such as MMPs or iNOS; reduction in protein tyrosine nitration because of scavenging properties; inhibition of activation of caspase-1 and caspase 3; enhancement of Bcl-2-derived effects which protects the cells against apoptosis; inhibition of the activity of PARP-1; reduction in the amount of p38 MAPK phosphorylation. All these activities of minocycline help in fighting against various bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE

Take MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. You can take MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE while sitting down or standing.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use by pregnant women or women who are planning to conceive, as it can affect the development of the foetus. Consult your doctor before taking it.
MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, spinning sensation while standing, headaches, eyesight problems, light-headedness, ringing in the ears or hearing problems after taking MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE. The absorption of MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE can be affected by food, milk or milk products.
MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE should be taken with caution in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE should be taken with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to minocycline.

Others

MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an autoimmune disorder where the immune system of the body attacks its tissue causing damage and inflammation of various parts of the body)
Have a need for dialysis management

Before taking MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (a condition which causes muscle weakening)

Use in paediatrics:

MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for under 12 years of age as it can affect growing bones and teeth and cause staining of teeth along with reduced enamel content in teeth. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

MINOZ OD 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About NIXIDOX CAPSULE

NIXIDOX CAPSULE is a combination of Doxycycline and Lactic Acid Bacillus, which belong to the groups of medicines called antibiotics and probiotics, respectively. It is used in adults prone to intra-abdominal bacterial infection and to manage antibiotic-associated diarrhoea.

Before taking NIXIDOX CAPSULE, inform your doctor about your pre-existing conditions, allergies or if you are taking any other medicines. NIXIDOX CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women or children (younger than 8 years), so consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking NIXIDOX CAPSULE are loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, rash, light sensitivity, hives and haemolytic anaemia. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse.

Take NIXIDOX CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will determine your correct dose and duration based on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Minolox 50mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MINOLOX 50MG TABLET

MINOLOX 50MG TABLET contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose, and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. It also helps in the management of meningitis carriers. It is also used in the management of infections before and after an operation.

Before taking MINOLOX 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking MINOLOX 50MG TABLET, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

MINOLOX 50MG TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding as it can affect the development of the unborn baby. MINOLOX 50MG TABLET should be used with caution by adults and adolescents but not recommended for use under the age of 12 years. The most common side effects of taking MINOLOX 50MG TABLET are dizziness and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MINOLOX 50MG TABLET Works

MINOLOX 50MG TABLET has properties of immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects. It can work by any of the following mechanism such as inhibitory effect on activities of enzymes such as MMPs or iNOS; reduction in protein tyrosine nitration because of scavenging properties; inhibition of activation of caspase-1 and caspase 3; enhancement of Bcl-2-derived effects which protects the cells against apoptosis; inhibition of the activity of PARP-1; reduction in the amount of p38 MAPK phosphorylation. All these activities of minocycline help in fighting against various bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MINOLOX 50MG TABLET

Take MINOLOX 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. You can take MINOLOX 50MG TABLET while sitting down or standing.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: MINOLOX 50MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use by pregnant women or women who are planning to conceive, as it can affect the development of the foetus. Consult your doctor before taking it.
MINOLOX 50MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, spinning sensation while standing, headaches, eyesight problems, light-headedness, ringing in the ears or hearing problems after taking MINOLOX 50MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MINOLOX 50MG TABLET. The absorption of MINOLOX 50MG TABLET can be affected by food, milk or milk products.
MINOLOX 50MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
MINOLOX 50MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take MINOLOX 50MG TABLET if you are allergic to minocycline.

Others

MINOLOX 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an autoimmune disorder where the immune system of the body attacks its tissue causing damage and inflammation of various parts of the body)
Have a need for dialysis management

Before taking MINOLOX 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (a condition which causes muscle weakening)

Use in paediatrics:

MINOLOX 50MG TABLET is generally not recommended for under 12 years of age as it can affect growing bones and teeth and cause staining of teeth along with reduced enamel content in teeth. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

MINOLOX 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MINOLOX 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Anticoagulants (used to thin blood) Ex. warfarin
Antacids (used to manage indigestion) Ex. – magnesium hydroxide and calcium carbonate
Hepatotoxic medicine (medicines that might affect the working of the liver)
Sucralfate and bismuth salts (used to manage ulcers)
Kaolin (used to manage diarrhoea)
Quinapril (ACE inhibitor, used to manage high blood pressure)
Antibiotic (a medicine used to manage infections) Ex. – penicillin
Diuretics Ex. bumetanide and furosemide
Retinoids (used to manage acne) Ex. isotretinoin or retinol
Ergotamine (used to manage migraines)
Ergometrine (used to induce labour or abortion)
Medicines containing zinc salts, calcium, iron, magnesium, or aluminium

B. Drug–Food Interactions:

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking MINOLOX 50MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects. The absorption of MINOLOX 50MG TABLET can be reduced by food, milk or milk products.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of MINOLOX 50MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness and feeling sick or nauseous.

introduction:
Introduction About MINOTAS ER 65MG TABLET

MINOTAS ER 65MG TABLET contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose, and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. It also helps in the management of meningitis carriers. It is also used in the management of infections before and after an operation.

Before taking MINOTAS ER 65MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking MINOTAS ER 65MG TABLET, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

MINOTAS ER 65MG TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding as it can affect the development of the unborn baby. MINOTAS ER 65MG TABLET should be used with caution by adults and adolescents but not recommended for use under the age of 12 years. The most common side effects of taking MINOTAS ER 65MG TABLET are dizziness and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET

MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose, and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. It also helps in the management of meningitis carriers. It is also used in the management of infections before and after an operation.

Before taking MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding as it can affect the development of the unborn baby. MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET should be used with caution by adults and adolescents but not recommended for use under the age of 12 years. The most common side effects of taking MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET are dizziness and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET Works

MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET has properties of immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects. It can work by any of the following mechanism such as inhibitory effect on activities of enzymes such as MMPs or iNOS; reduction in protein tyrosine nitration because of scavenging properties; inhibition of activation of caspase-1 and caspase 3; enhancement of Bcl-2-derived effects which protects the cells against apoptosis; inhibition of the activity of PARP-1; reduction in the amount of p38 MAPK phosphorylation. All these activities of minocycline help in fighting against various bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET

Take MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. You can take MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET while sitting down or standing.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use by pregnant women or women who are planning to conceive, as it can affect the development of the foetus. Consult your doctor before taking it.
MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, spinning sensation while standing, headaches, eyesight problems, light-headedness, ringing in the ears or hearing problems after taking MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET. The absorption of MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET can be affected by food, milk or milk products.
MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET if you are allergic to minocycline.

Others

MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an autoimmune disorder where the immune system of the body attacks its tissue causing damage and inflammation of various parts of the body)
Have a need for dialysis management

Before taking MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (a condition which causes muscle weakening)

Use in paediatrics:

MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET is generally not recommended for under 12 years of age as it can affect growing bones and teeth and cause staining of teeth along with reduced enamel content in teeth. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Anticoagulants (used to thin blood) Ex. warfarin
Antacids (used to manage indigestion) Ex. – magnesium hydroxide and calcium carbonate
Hepatotoxic medicine (medicines that might affect the working of the liver)
Sucralfate and bismuth salts (used to manage ulcers)
Kaolin (used to manage diarrhoea)
Quinapril (ACE inhibitor, used to manage high blood pressure)
Antibiotic (a medicine used to manage infections) Ex. – penicillin
Diuretics Ex. bumetanide and furosemide
Retinoids (used to manage acne) Ex. isotretinoin or retinol
Ergotamine (used to manage migraines)
Ergometrine (used to induce labour or abortion)
Medicines containing zinc salts, calcium, iron, magnesium, or aluminium

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects. The absorption of MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET can be reduced by food, milk or milk products.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of MINONIL ER 65MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness and feeling sick or nauseous.

name: Doxybond LB Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About DOXYBOND LB CAPSULE

DOXYBOND LB CAPSULE is a combination of Doxycycline and Lactic Acid Bacillus, which belong to the groups of medicines called antibiotics and probiotics, respectively. It is used in adults prone to intra-abdominal bacterial infection and to manage antibiotic-associated diarrhoea.

Before taking DOXYBOND LB CAPSULE, inform your doctor about your pre-existing conditions, allergies or if you are taking any other medicines. DOXYBOND LB CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women or children (younger than 8 years), so consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking DOXYBOND LB CAPSULE are loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, rash, light sensitivity, hives and haemolytic anaemia. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse.
uses: Manage intra-abdominal bacterial infection
Manage antibiotic-associated diarrhea
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOXYBOND LB CAPSULE
Manage intra-abdominal bacterial infection
Manage antibiotic-associated diarrhea
mechanismOfAction:
How DOXYBOND LB CAPSULE Works

DOXYBOND LB CAPSULE improves gastrointestinal symptoms where doxycycline gets accumulated inside the bacteria, gets attached to the 30S subunit of the bacterial ribosome and inhibits bacterial protein synthesis; lactobacillus restores the natural microbial flora within the digestive tract and helps in the breakdown of food, resulting in the production of lactic acid, hydrogen peroxide and other by-products.
usageDetails:
How to use DOXYBOND LB CAPSULE

Take DOXYBOND LB CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will determine your correct dose and duration based on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Light sensitivity causing extreme sunburn reaction

introduction:
Introduction About MINOLOX 100MG TABLET

MINOLOX 100MG TABLET contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose, and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. It also helps in the management of meningitis carriers. It is also used in the management of infections before and after an operation.

Before taking MINOLOX 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking MINOLOX 100MG TABLET, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

MINOLOX 100MG TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding as it can affect the development of the unborn baby. MINOLOX 100MG TABLET should be used with caution by adults and adolescents but not recommended for use under the age of 12 years. The most common side effects of taking MINOLOX 100MG TABLET are dizziness and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MINOLOX 100MG TABLET Works

MINOLOX 100MG TABLET has properties of immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects. It can work by any of the following mechanism such as inhibitory effect on activities of enzymes such as MMPs or iNOS; reduction in protein tyrosine nitration because of scavenging properties; inhibition of activation of caspase-1 and caspase 3; enhancement of Bcl-2-derived effects which protects the cells against apoptosis; inhibition of the activity of PARP-1; reduction in the amount of p38 MAPK phosphorylation. All these activities of minocycline help in fighting against various bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MINOLOX 100MG TABLET

Take MINOLOX 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. You can take MINOLOX 100MG TABLET while sitting down or standing.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DOXY 1 L DR FORTE CAPSULE

DOXY 1 L DR FORTE CAPSULE is a combination of Doxycycline and Lactic Acid Bacillus, which belong to the groups of medicines called antibiotics and probiotics, respectively. It is used in adults prone to intra-abdominal bacterial infection and to manage antibiotic-associated diarrhoea.

Before taking DOXY 1 L DR FORTE CAPSULE, inform your doctor about your pre-existing conditions, allergies or if you are taking any other medicines. DOXY 1 L DR FORTE CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women or children (younger than 8 years), so consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking DOXY 1 L DR FORTE CAPSULE are loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, rash, light sensitivity, hives and haemolytic anaemia. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse.
uses: Manage intra-abdominal bacterial infection
Manage antibiotic-associated diarrhea
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOXY 1 L DR FORTE CAPSULE
Manage intra-abdominal bacterial infection
Manage antibiotic-associated diarrhea
mechanismOfAction:
How DOXY 1 L DR FORTE CAPSULE Works

DOXY 1 L DR FORTE CAPSULE improves gastrointestinal symptoms where doxycycline gets accumulated inside the bacteria, gets attached to the 30S subunit of the bacterial ribosome and inhibits bacterial protein synthesis; lactobacillus restores the natural microbial flora within the digestive tract and helps in the breakdown of food, resulting in the production of lactic acid, hydrogen peroxide and other by-products.
usageDetails:
How to use DOXY 1 L DR FORTE CAPSULE

Take DOXY 1 L DR FORTE CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will determine your correct dose and duration based on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About DIVAINE 100 INJECTION

It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. Before taking DIVAINE 100 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking DIVAINE 100 INJECTION, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How DIVAINE 100 INJECTION Works

DIVAINE 100 INJECTION has properties of immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects. It can work by any of the following mechanism such as inhibitory effect on activities of enzymes such as MMPs or iNOS; reduction in protein tyrosine nitration because of scavenging properties; inhibition of activation of caspase-1 and caspase 3; enhancement of Bcl-2-derived effects which protects the cells against apoptosis; inhibition of the activity of PARP-1; reduction in the amount of p38 MAPK phosphorylation. All these activities of minocycline help in fighting against various bacterial infections.

DIVAINE 100 INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

DIVAINE 100 INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an autoimmune disorder where the immune system of the body attacks its tissue causing damage and inflammation of various parts of the body)
Have a need for dialysis management

Before taking DIVAINE 100 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (a condition which causes muscle weakening)

DIVAINE 100 INJECTION is generally not recommended for under 8 years of age as it can affect growing bones and teeth and cause staining of teeth along with reduced enamel content in teeth. Consult your doctor before taking it.

DIVAINE 100 INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially over the age of 65 years. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About DOXT 100MG COMBIPACK INJECTION

DOXT 100MG COMBIPACK INJECTION contains Doxycycline which belongs to the groups of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used for the management of various bacterial infections like that of respiratory tract, urinary tract, skin, eyes, digestive system, bones, blood, etc. DOXT 100MG COMBIPACK INJECTION is also used to manage sexually transmitted infections (Ex. syphilis, gonorrhoea, chlamydia), plague (spreads through rats), cholera (spreads through contaminated water), brucellosis (spreads from animals to human by eating raw dairy products), anthrax (spreads from sheep or cattle), etc.

DOXT 100MG COMBIPACK INJECTION can also be used to manage malaria in short-term travellers (<4 months) to areas with chloroquine- and/or pyrimethamine sulphadoxine-resistant strains. It is advised to reduce sun exposure and to use fully covering clothes and sunscreen while going out as there is a chance of getting light sensitivity during management with DOXT 100MG COMBIPACK INJECTION.

Before receiving DOXT 100MG COMBIPACK INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, history of intracranial hypertension or oral candidiasis, liver or kidney problems, porphyria or if you are an overweight woman of childbearing age.

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies on the use of DOXT 100MG COMBIPACK INJECTION in pregnant women. DOXT 100MG COMBIPACK INJECTION should be used in breastfeeding women only if your doctor finds it necessary. DOXT 100MG COMBIPACK INJECTION should be used in children (8 years of age or less) only if the potential benefits outweigh the risks.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during DOXT 100MG COMBIPACK INJECTION management. The most common side effects of receiving DOXT 100MG COMBIPACK INJECTION are mild diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, light sensitivity, skin rash or itching, headaches and tooth discoloration. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen with time.

introduction:
Introduction About MINYM ER 65MG TABLET

MINYM ER 65MG TABLET contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose, and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. It also helps in the management of meningitis carriers. It is also used in the management of infections before and after an operation.

Before taking MINYM ER 65MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking MINYM ER 65MG TABLET, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

MINYM ER 65MG TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding as it can affect the development of the unborn baby. MINYM ER 65MG TABLET should be used with caution by adults and adolescents but not recommended for use under the age of 12 years. The most common side effects of taking MINYM ER 65MG TABLET are dizziness and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MINOZ ER 45MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Anticoagulants (used to thin blood) Ex. warfarin
Antacids (used to manage indigestion) Ex. – magnesium hydroxide and calcium carbonate

Sucralfate and bismuth salts (used to manage ulcers)
Kaolin (used to manage diarrhoea)
Quinapril (ACE inhibitor, used to manage high blood pressure)
Antibiotic (a medicine used to manage infections) Ex. – penicillin

Ergometrine (used to induce labour or abortion)
Medicines containing zinc salts, calcium, iron, magnesium, or aluminium

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking MINOZ ER 45MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects. The absorption of MINOZ ER 45MG TABLET can be reduced by food, milk or milk products.

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of MINOZ ER 45MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness and feeling sick or nauseous.

introduction:
Introduction About BIODOXI LB CAPSULE

BIODOXI LB CAPSULE is a combination of Doxycycline and Lactic Acid Bacillus, which belong to the groups of medicines called antibiotics and probiotics, respectively. It is used in adults prone to intra-abdominal bacterial infection and to manage antibiotic-associated diarrhoea.

Before taking BIODOXI LB CAPSULE, inform your doctor about your pre-existing conditions, allergies or if you are taking any other medicines. BIODOXI LB CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women or children (younger than 8 years), so consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking BIODOXI LB CAPSULE are loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, rash, light sensitivity, hives and haemolytic anaemia. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse.

Manage antibiotic-associated diarrhea
usesDetails:

Manage intra-abdominal bacterial infection

mechanismOfAction:
How BIODOXI LB CAPSULE Works

BIODOXI LB CAPSULE improves gastrointestinal symptoms where doxycycline gets accumulated inside the bacteria, gets attached to the 30S subunit of the bacterial ribosome and inhibits bacterial protein synthesis; lactobacillus restores the natural microbial flora within the digestive tract and helps in the breakdown of food, resulting in the production of lactic acid, hydrogen peroxide and other by-products.

Take BIODOXI LB CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will determine your correct dose and duration based on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, spinning sensation while standing, headaches, eyesight problems, light-headedness, ringing in the ears or hearing problems after taking CNN MR 100MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CNN MR 100MG TABLET. The absorption of CNN MR 100MG TABLET can be affected by food, milk or milk products.
CNN MR 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
CNN MR 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CNN MR 100MG TABLET if you are allergic to minocycline.

Others

CNN MR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an autoimmune disorder where the immune system of the body attacks its tissue causing damage and inflammation of various parts of the body)
Have a need for dialysis management

Before taking CNN MR 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (a condition which causes muscle weakening)

Use in paediatrics:

CNN MR 100MG TABLET is generally not recommended for under 12 years of age as it can affect growing bones and teeth and cause staining of teeth along with reduced enamel content in teeth. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

CNN MR 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CNN MR 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Anticoagulants (used to thin blood) Ex. warfarin
Antacids (used to manage indigestion) Ex. – magnesium hydroxide and calcium carbonate
Hepatotoxic medicine (medicines that might affect the working of the liver)
Sucralfate and bismuth salts (used to manage ulcers)
Kaolin (used to manage diarrhoea)
Quinapril (ACE inhibitor, used to manage high blood pressure)
Antibiotic (a medicine used to manage infections) Ex. – penicillin
Diuretics Ex. bumetanide and furosemide
Retinoids (used to manage acne) Ex. isotretinoin or retinol
Ergotamine (used to manage migraines)
Ergometrine (used to induce labour or abortion)
Medicines containing zinc salts, calcium, iron, magnesium, or aluminium

B. Drug–Food Interactions:

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking CNN MR 100MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects. The absorption of CNN MR 100MG TABLET can be reduced by food, milk or milk products.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of CNN MR 100MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness and feeling sick or nauseous.

introduction:
Introduction About A DOXID CAPSULE

A DOXID CAPSULE contains Doxycycline which belongs to group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used for the management of various bacterial infections like that of chest, lung or nose (Ex. bronchitis, pneumonia, sinusitis), urinary tract (Ex. cystitis, urethritis), skin (Ex. acne), eyes or sexually transmitted diseases (Ex. gonorrhoea, syphilis, chlamydia).

A DOXID CAPSULE is also used to manage fevers associated with louse or tick bites and malaria (when chloroquine is ineffective). A DOXID CAPSULE can also be used to manage certain infections like scrub typhus (a disease carried by small insects), Rocky Mountain spotted fever, travellers’ diarrhoea, malaria and leptospirosis.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with A DOXID CAPSULE, as it may reduce the efficacy of this medicine. Before taking A DOXID CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, liver or kidney problems, porphyria, diarrhea or suspected syphilis.

A DOXID CAPSULE is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant, planning to become pregnant or breast-feeding. A DOXID CAPSULE should be used in children (8 years of age or less) only if the potential benefits outweigh the risks.

You should avoid exposure to strong sunlight while taking A DOXID CAPSULE as your skin may be more sensitive to sunburn than normal. The most common side effects of taking A DOXID CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, joint pain, skin rash, fever, headache, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse with time.

Manage fevers associated with louse or tick bites and malaria (when chloroquine is ineffective)

How A DOXID CAPSULE Works

A DOXID CAPSULE reduces bacterial infection by blocking protein synthesis of bacteria and thus managing its growth.

How to use A DOXID CAPSULE

Take A DOXID CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Do not crush or chew it. Swallow with a glass of water. The dose and duration will be determined by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking A DOXID CAPSULE unless your doctor advises you to stop.

A DOXID CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
A DOXID CAPSULE should not affect your ability to drive or use machines. Consult your doctor for advice.

A DOXID CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.
A DOXID CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take A DOXID CAPSULE if you are allergic to doxycycline, minocycline, tetracycline or any of the other ingredients of this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking A DOXID CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Are likely to be exposed to strong sunlight or UV light (Ex. on a sun bed)
Have myasthenia gravis (disease which causes unusual tiredness and weakness of certain muscles, particularly in the eyelid)
Have porphyria (rare blood disease)
Have or had systemic lupus erythematosus (an immune system disease that causes joint pain, skin rashes and fever)
Are suspected to have syphilis
Have diarrhoea or usually get diarrhoea after taking antibiotics
Have stomach or bowel problems
Are about to have any operation or dental surgery

Use in Pediatrics:

A DOXID CAPSULE should be used in children (8 years of age or less) only if the potential benefits outweigh the risks. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

A DOXID CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (75 years and older). Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Cynomycin 100mg Capsule 4'S
introduction:
Introduction About CYNOMYCIN 100MG CAPSULE

CYNOMYCIN 100MG CAPSULE contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose, and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. It also helps in the management of meningitis carriers. It is also used in the management of infections before and after an operation.

Before taking CYNOMYCIN 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking CYNOMYCIN 100MG CAPSULE, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

CYNOMYCIN 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding as it can affect the development of the unborn baby. CYNOMYCIN 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution by adults and adolescents but not recommended for use under the age of 12 years. The most common side effects of taking CYNOMYCIN 100MG CAPSULE are dizziness and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage varied types of infections, such as bacterial infections that affect ears, eyes, throat, nose and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections
Manage meningitis carriers
Prevention of infection before and after an operation

mechanismOfAction:
How CYNOMYCIN 100MG CAPSULE Works

CYNOMYCIN 100MG CAPSULE has properties of immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects. It can work by any of the following mechanism such as inhibitory effect on activities of enzymes such as MMPs or iNOS; reduction in protein tyrosine nitration because of scavenging properties; inhibition of activation of caspase-1 and caspase 3; enhancement of Bcl-2-derived effects which protects the cells against apoptosis; inhibition of the activity of PARP-1; reduction in the amount of p38 MAPK phosphorylation. All these activities of minocycline help in fighting against various bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use CYNOMYCIN 100MG CAPSULE

Take CYNOMYCIN 100MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. You can take CYNOMYCIN 100MG CAPSULE while sitting down or standing.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LENTECLIN 100MG CAPSULE

LENTECLIN 100MG CAPSULE contains Doxycycline which belongs to group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used for the management of various bacterial infections like that of chest, lung or nose (Ex. bronchitis, pneumonia, sinusitis), urinary tract (Ex. cystitis, urethritis), skin (Ex. acne), eyes or sexually transmitted diseases (Ex. gonorrhoea, syphilis, chlamydia).

LENTECLIN 100MG CAPSULE is also used to manage fevers associated with louse or tick bites and malaria (when chloroquine is ineffective). LENTECLIN 100MG CAPSULE can also be used to manage certain infections like scrub typhus (a disease carried by small insects), Rocky Mountain spotted fever, travellers’ diarrhoea, malaria and leptospirosis.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with LENTECLIN 100MG CAPSULE, as it may reduce the efficacy of this medicine. Before taking LENTECLIN 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, liver or kidney problems, porphyria, diarrhea or suspected syphilis.

LENTECLIN 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant, planning to become pregnant or breast-feeding. LENTECLIN 100MG CAPSULE should be used in children (8 years of age or less) only if the potential benefits outweigh the risks.

You should avoid exposure to strong sunlight while taking LENTECLIN 100MG CAPSULE as your skin may be more sensitive to sunburn than normal. The most common side effects of taking LENTECLIN 100MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, joint pain, skin rash, fever, headache, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse with time.

introduction:
Introduction About CYNOMYCIN 50MG CAPSULE

CYNOMYCIN 50MG CAPSULE contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose, and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. It also helps in the management of meningitis carriers. It is also used in the management of infections before and after an operation.

Before taking CYNOMYCIN 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking CYNOMYCIN 50MG CAPSULE, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

CYNOMYCIN 50MG CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding as it can affect the development of the unborn baby. CYNOMYCIN 50MG CAPSULE should be used with caution by adults and adolescents but not recommended for use under the age of 12 years. The most common side effects of taking CYNOMYCIN 50MG CAPSULE are dizziness and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
