mechanismOfAction:
How CYNOMYCIN 50MG CAPSULE Works

CYNOMYCIN 50MG CAPSULE has properties of immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects. It can work by any of the following mechanism such as inhibitory effect on activities of enzymes such as MMPs or iNOS; reduction in protein tyrosine nitration because of scavenging properties; inhibition of activation of caspase-1 and caspase 3; enhancement of Bcl-2-derived effects which protects the cells against apoptosis; inhibition of the activity of PARP-1; reduction in the amount of p38 MAPK phosphorylation. All these activities of minocycline help in fighting against various bacterial infections.

Take CYNOMYCIN 50MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. You can take CYNOMYCIN 50MG CAPSULE while sitting down or standing.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NUDOXY CAPSULE

NUDOXY CAPSULE contains Doxycycline which belongs to group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used for the management of various bacterial infections like that of chest, lung or nose (Ex. bronchitis, pneumonia, sinusitis), urinary tract (Ex. cystitis, urethritis), skin (Ex. acne), eyes or sexually transmitted diseases (Ex. gonorrhoea, syphilis, chlamydia).

NUDOXY CAPSULE is also used to manage fevers associated with louse or tick bites and malaria (when chloroquine is ineffective). NUDOXY CAPSULE can also be used to manage certain infections like scrub typhus (a disease carried by small insects), Rocky Mountain spotted fever, travellers’ diarrhoea, malaria and leptospirosis.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with NUDOXY CAPSULE, as it may reduce the efficacy of this medicine. Before taking NUDOXY CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, liver or kidney problems, porphyria, diarrhea or suspected syphilis.

NUDOXY CAPSULE is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant, planning to become pregnant or breast-feeding. NUDOXY CAPSULE should be used in children (8 years of age or less) only if the potential benefits outweigh the risks.

You should avoid exposure to strong sunlight while taking NUDOXY CAPSULE as your skin may be more sensitive to sunburn than normal. The most common side effects of taking NUDOXY CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, joint pain, skin rash, fever, headache, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse with time.

name: Divaine 50mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About DIVAINE 50MG TABLET

DIVAINE 50MG TABLET contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose, and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. It also helps in the management of meningitis carriers. It is also used in the management of infections before and after an operation.

Before taking DIVAINE 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking DIVAINE 50MG TABLET, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

DIVAINE 50MG TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding as it can affect the development of the unborn baby. DIVAINE 50MG TABLET should be used with caution by adults and adolescents but not recommended for use under the age of 12 years. The most common side effects of taking DIVAINE 50MG TABLET are dizziness and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DIVAINE 50MG TABLET Works

DIVAINE 50MG TABLET has properties of immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects. It can work by any of the following mechanism such as inhibitory effect on activities of enzymes such as MMPs or iNOS; reduction in protein tyrosine nitration because of scavenging properties; inhibition of activation of caspase-1 and caspase 3; enhancement of Bcl-2-derived effects which protects the cells against apoptosis; inhibition of the activity of PARP-1; reduction in the amount of p38 MAPK phosphorylation. All these activities of minocycline help in fighting against various bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use DIVAINE 50MG TABLET

Take DIVAINE 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. You can take DIVAINE 50MG TABLET while sitting down or standing.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, spinning sensation while standing, headaches, eyesight problems, light-headedness, ringing in the ears or hearing problems after taking DIVAINE 50MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DIVAINE 50MG TABLET. The absorption of DIVAINE 50MG TABLET can be affected by food, milk or milk products.
DIVAINE 50MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
DIVAINE 50MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take DIVAINE 50MG TABLET if you are allergic to minocycline.

Others

DIVAINE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an autoimmune disorder where the immune system of the body attacks its tissue causing damage and inflammation of various parts of the body)
Have a need for dialysis management

Before taking DIVAINE 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (a condition which causes muscle weakening)

Use in paediatrics:

DIVAINE 50MG TABLET is generally not recommended for under 12 years of age as it can affect growing bones and teeth and cause staining of teeth along with reduced enamel content in teeth. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

DIVAINE 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking DIVAINE 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Anticoagulants (used to thin blood) Ex. warfarin
Antacids (used to manage indigestion) Ex. – magnesium hydroxide and calcium carbonate
Hepatotoxic medicine (medicines that might affect the working of the liver)
Sucralfate and bismuth salts (used to manage ulcers)
Kaolin (used to manage diarrhoea)
Quinapril (ACE inhibitor, used to manage high blood pressure)
Antibiotic (a medicine used to manage infections) Ex. – penicillin
Diuretics Ex. bumetanide and furosemide
Retinoids (used to manage acne) Ex. isotretinoin or retinol
Ergotamine (used to manage migraines)
Ergometrine (used to induce labour or abortion)
Medicines containing zinc salts, calcium, iron, magnesium, or aluminium

B. Drug–Food Interactions:

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking DIVAINE 50MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects. The absorption of DIVAINE 50MG TABLET can be reduced by food, milk or milk products.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of DIVAINE 50MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness and feeling sick or nauseous.

name: Doxific 100mg Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION

DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION contains Doxycycline which belongs to the groups of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used for the management of various bacterial infections like that of respiratory tract, urinary tract, skin, eyes, digestive system, bones, blood, etc. DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION is also used to manage sexually transmitted infections (Ex. syphilis, gonorrhoea, chlamydia), plague (spreads through rats), cholera (spreads through contaminated water), brucellosis (spreads from animals to human by eating raw dairy products), anthrax (spreads from sheep or cattle), etc.

DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION can also be used to manage malaria in short-term travellers (<4 months) to areas with chloroquine- and/or pyrimethamine sulphadoxine-resistant strains. It is advised to reduce sun exposure and to use fully covering clothes and sunscreen while going out as there is a chance of getting light sensitivity during management with DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION.

Before receiving DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, history of intracranial hypertension or oral candidiasis, liver or kidney problems, porphyria or if you are an overweight woman of childbearing age.

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies on the use of DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION in pregnant women. DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION should be used in breastfeeding women only if your doctor finds it necessary. DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION should be used in children (8 years of age or less) only if the potential benefits outweigh the risks.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION management. The most common side effects of receiving DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION are mild diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, light sensitivity, skin rash or itching, headaches and tooth discoloration. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen with time.

How DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION Works

DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION reduces bacterial infection by blocking protein synthesis of bacteria and thus managing its growth.
usageDetails:
How to use DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION

DOXIFIC 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Do not try to self-administer the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Tygacil 50mg Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About TYGACIL INJECTION

TYGACIL INJECTION contains a medicine Tigecycline which belongs to a group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage serious infections such as complicated infection of the skin and soft tissues (the tissue below the skin), excluding diabetic foot infections.

TYGACIL INJECTION is also used to manage complicated infection in the abdomen. It is used when your doctor thinks that other antibiotics will not suit you.

Before receiving TYGACIL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have liver diseases, slow or poor wound healing, diarrhoea, blockage of the bile ducts, allergy to tetracycline antibiotics or bleeding disorders.

TYGACIL INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TYGACIL INJECTION is not recommended for use in children below 8 years of age. TYGACIL INJECTION can be used in elderly patients, however, consult with your doctor before receiving.

The most common side effects of receiving TYGACIL INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, injection site pain or inflammation or dizziness. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

How TYGACIL INJECTION Works

TYGACIL INJECTION acts on the bacteria and disrupt the important life functions of the bacteria. It interferes with the present bacteria and disrupts the cell membrane along with hampering its various cellular function which leads to bacterial death.

Bleeding disorders

TYGACIL INJECTION can be used in elderly patients. However, consult your doctor before receiving it.

introduction:
Introduction About DIVAINE 100MG TABLET

DIVAINE 100MG TABLET contains Minocycline, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of bacterial infections that affect the ears, eyes, throat, nose, and respiratory system (chest infections), gonorrhoea or pelvic, skin infections (acne), urinary tract infections and prostate infections. It also helps in the management of meningitis carriers. It is also used in the management of infections before and after an operation.

Before taking DIVAINE 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had liver or kidney problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol, milk or milk products while taking DIVAINE 100MG TABLET, as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

DIVAINE 100MG TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding as it can affect the development of the unborn baby. DIVAINE 100MG TABLET should be used with caution by adults and adolescents but not recommended for use under the age of 12 years. The most common side effects of taking DIVAINE 100MG TABLET are dizziness and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DIVAINE 100MG TABLET Works

DIVAINE 100MG TABLET has properties of immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects. It can work by any of the following mechanism such as inhibitory effect on activities of enzymes such as MMPs or iNOS; reduction in protein tyrosine nitration because of scavenging properties; inhibition of activation of caspase-1 and caspase 3; enhancement of Bcl-2-derived effects which protects the cells against apoptosis; inhibition of the activity of PARP-1; reduction in the amount of p38 MAPK phosphorylation. All these activities of minocycline help in fighting against various bacterial infections.

Take DIVAINE 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. You can take DIVAINE 100MG TABLET while sitting down or standing.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an autoimmune disorder where the immune system of the body attacks its tissue causing damage and inflammation of various parts of the body)

Before taking DIVAINE 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (a condition which causes muscle weakening)

DIVAINE 100MG TABLET is generally not recommended for under 12 years of age as it can affect growing bones and teeth and cause staining of teeth along with reduced enamel content in teeth. Consult your doctor before taking it.

DIVAINE 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking DIVAINE 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Anticoagulants (used to thin blood) Ex. warfarin
Antacids (used to manage indigestion) Ex. – magnesium hydroxide and calcium carbonate
Hepatotoxic medicine (medicines that might affect the working of the liver)
Sucralfate and bismuth salts (used to manage ulcers)
Kaolin (used to manage diarrhoea)
Quinapril (ACE inhibitor, used to manage high blood pressure)
Antibiotic (a medicine used to manage infections) Ex. – penicillin
Diuretics Ex. bumetanide and furosemide
Retinoids (used to manage acne) Ex. isotretinoin or retinol
Ergotamine (used to manage migraines)
Ergometrine (used to induce labour or abortion)
Medicines containing zinc salts, calcium, iron, magnesium, or aluminium

B. Drug–Food Interactions:

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking DIVAINE 100MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects. The absorption of DIVAINE 100MG TABLET can be reduced by food, milk or milk products.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of DIVAINE 100MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are dizziness and feeling sick or nauseous.

introduction:
Introduction About TIGENICHE 50MG INJECTION

TIGENICHE 50MG INJECTION contains a medicine Tigecycline which belongs to a group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage serious infections such as complicated infection of the skin and soft tissues (the tissue below the skin), excluding diabetic foot infections.

TIGENICHE 50MG INJECTION is also used to manage complicated infection in the abdomen. It is used when your doctor thinks that other antibiotics will not suit you.

Before receiving TIGENICHE 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have liver diseases, slow or poor wound healing, diarrhoea, blockage of the bile ducts, allergy to tetracycline antibiotics or bleeding disorders.

TIGENICHE 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TIGENICHE 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children below 8 years of age. TIGENICHE 50MG INJECTION can be used in elderly patients, however, consult with your doctor before receiving.

The most common side effects of receiving TIGENICHE 50MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, injection site pain or inflammation or dizziness. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

Complicated infection in the abdomen

How TIGENICHE 50MG INJECTION Works

TIGENICHE 50MG INJECTION acts on the bacteria and disrupt the important life functions of the bacteria. It interferes with the present bacteria and disrupts the cell membrane along with hampering its various cellular function which leads to bacterial death.

TIGENICHE 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TIGENICHE 50MG INJECTION for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

Slow or poor wound healing
Diarrhoea
Blockage of the bile ducts
Allergy to tetracycline antibiotics (skin sensitization to sun light, staining on developing teeth, inflammation of pancreas, decreased ability to form blood clot)
Bleeding disorders

Use in pediatrics:

TIGENICHE 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children less than 8 years of age due to the lack of data on safety and efficacy in this age group. Also, it may cause permanent dental defects such as staining on the developing teeth. Consult with your child’s doctor.

Use in geriatrics:

TIGENICHE 50MG INJECTION can be used in elderly patients. However, consult your doctor before receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How TIGEZ 50MG INJECTION Works

TIGEZ 50MG INJECTION acts on the bacteria and disrupt the important life functions of the bacteria. It interferes with the present bacteria and disrupts the cell membrane along with hampering its various cellular function which leads to bacterial death.

TIGEZ 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TIGEZ 50MG INJECTION for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Laboratory measurement of decreased ability to form blood clots (low platelets)
Dizziness

Increases in liver enzymes
Hyperbilirubinaemia (excess of bile pigments in the blood)
Pruritus (itching), rash
Poor or slow wound healing
Headache

Pneumonia

Low protein levels in the blood
Jaundice (yellow coloration of the skin)
Inflammation of the liver
Low fibrinogen levels in the blood (a protein involved in blood clotting)
Pseudomembranous colitis
Serious bowel inflammation symptoms such as bloody diarrhoea, abdominal pain or fever
Severe abdominal pain, nausea and vomiting (pancreatitis)
